name: khelben arunsun
lore:
To encounter the Blackstaff is to stand before the very keystone of Waterdeep’s magical ecology. Khelben Arunsun dwells within his obsidian spire, a predator of chaos who treats the Weave as his private garden. He does not merely inhabit the City of Splendors; he functions as its silent, vigilant immune system, pruning threats before they ever bloom.

In behavior, Khelben is as unyielding as the staff he carries. He is a creature of deep time and deeper secrets, viewing the world through the lens of centuries rather than seasons. His manner is that of a stern, impatient patriarch; he suffers no fools and speaks only when silence no longer serves. He moves with a calculated gravity, his presence heavy with the scent of ozone and ancient parchment. To the unwary, he is a shadow; to the city, he is the iron wall between order and oblivion.
